verdict.rationale: Conta Simples's core product is a regulated digital business account: Pix, boletos, corporate and virtual card issuing, and cashback. These can only run on the provider's licensed banking infrastructure, so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence (hosted API docs, OAuth client credentials, llms.txt) shows only a hosted service consumed via API, with no sign of a self-hostable distribution that would make the axis apply.
